fieldDescription: In Story mode the Colony Autopilot starts dormant and is unlocked through the story. Off makes every function available from the start, and each save keeps its story progress through any switch.

defaultValue: Each preset sets several Advanced tab fields at once. Mode default returns the group to the empire mode's values, and Custom indicates fields that match no preset, so selecting it changes nothing.

fieldDescription: Sets how expensive the autopilot is. Hard keeps every price as balanced, while Normal lowers story bandwidth prices to three quarters and Easy to half, with fed AI cores worth more and convenience fees low on both.

secondaryValue: Low profile, Normal, High profile, Custom
fieldDescription: Sets how the empire grows. Low profile avoids attention and founds no colonies, Normal expands into held systems and defends what it builds, and High profile expands as fast and wide as it can with every AI core available.

Empire-wide directives follow this setting. In Off the autopilot takes no action, in Advisor it only recommends, in Approve it waits for administrator consent, and in Auto it executes immediately. Values set by the administrator are retained when the mode changes.
Colony crises advance slower in exchange for lower earnings. AI cores are kept out of colonies above size 3, and Pather interest, free ports, raids and sabotage are avoided. Off means Full expansion.

secondaryValue: Thrifty, Normal, Lavish, Mode default, Custom
fieldDescription: Monthly expenditure is allocated from net income and savings. Thrifty allocates 30%% and 5%%, Normal 50%% and 15%%, and Lavish 80%% and 30%%, with the per-project ceiling scaled to half, all or twice net income.
